$comment: First-load JS budgets in gzip KB (1024 bytes), enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after `pnpm build`. Groups: `interactive` = routes under an (interactive) route group; `read` = every other route, including (auth) and top-level pages. Per-route overrides go in `routes`, keyed by URL path: { "/reports": { "gzipKb": 160, "reason": "..." } }.
